notes: דִּבְרֵי and יָּמִים share the single word chronicles as a noncompositional unit, exactly as rule 30 states, with the separately segmented article taking the written the; the source head falls to the first token under rule 6, neither noun's lexeme being written in that one English word.
The fronted are (t012) is the interrogative particle's under rules 17 and 20, being at once the question auxiliary and the verbless clause's copula; הֵם keeps its own they and the negative its not.
